name: Valuation uncertainty

subjectOf.text: An ICO that proposes an uncapped raise without an underlying product is a very serious red flag, because uncapped raises are perceived by the crypto community as greedy and raise investor uncertainty about the valuation of the platform or product being bought.
subjectOf.abstract: First, ICOs that propose uncapped raises without an underlying product constitute a very serious red flag for any investor.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Marco Dell'Erba, Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3067615

subjectOf.text: Digital asset valuation uncertainty is produced by the combination of an immature digital asset market and a valuation infrastructure, legal, accounting, finance, technology, and back office, that was not built for these assets.
subjectOf.abstract: The valuation infrastructure in the current legal, accounting, finance, technology, and back-office framework in combination with the immaturity of the digital asset market create an environment where digital asset valuation continues to be a mystery.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Hayley Howe, Digital Asset Valuation (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4033886
scope_conditions: current state of the digital asset market
